import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.resource import Rows
from src.service import stream_rows
r = Rows([1, 2, 3])
assert list(stream_rows(r, lambda value: value * 2)) == [2, 4, 6]
assert (r.reads, r.closes) == (4, 1)

from src.consumer import take
r = Rows([1, 2, 3]); assert take(r, lambda v: v, 2) == [1, 2] and r.closes == 1 and r.reads == 2
r = Rows([1]); assert take(r, lambda v: v, 0) == [] and (r.reads, r.closes) == (0, 0)
r = Rows([1, 2, 3])
def bad(v):
    if v == 2: raise ValueError("t")
    return v
try: list(stream_rows(r, bad)); assert 0
except ValueError: pass
assert (r.reads, r.closes) == (2, 1)
g = stream_rows(r, bad); g.close(); assert (r.reads, r.closes) == (2, 1)
r = Rows([1, 2]); g = stream_rows(r, lambda v: v); next(g); g.close(); g.close()
assert (r.reads, r.closes) == (1, 1)
class BadClose(Rows):
    def close(self): super().close(); raise RuntimeError("c")
r = BadClose([1, 2])
try: list(stream_rows(r, bad)); assert 0
except ValueError: pass
r = BadClose([1]);
try: list(stream_rows(r, lambda v: v)); assert 0
except RuntimeError: pass
assert r.closes == 1
